name: Wei Long
institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
biography: I am a Ph.D. student in the Data Intelligence Group at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China. My research spans image restoration, 3D vision, and visual generative modeling.
researchIntro: I study how visual models restore fine detail, reconstruct 3D scenes, and generate images. My recent work explores efficient transformers, generalizable Gaussian splatting, and autoregressive image modeling.
